configuration.diagnostic_scope: Any new tail analysis uses only the intersection of the two fitting partitions. No December or hidden ranking labels. New feature or offset hypotheses require a separately declared later batch.
configuration.refit_iterations: rounded median of October-selected iterations separately for each model component and seed
configuration.seed_anchor_rule: among initial candidates improving both complete folds and the reference, minimize mean RMSE ratio to reference; refit every component of that recipe with each declared seed
configuration.selection: require at least 0.5 percent RMSE improvement on each complete fold over v3; minimize mean relative RMSE among the declared candidates and blends

seed_plan.rule: among initial candidates improving both complete folds and the reference, minimize mean RMSE ratio to reference; refit every component of that recipe with each declared seed
